findings: The held-out combined model predicted MAE 0.09327, 0.08046 and 0.06160 for 7x4, 14x4 and 49x4, while observed means were 0.08815, 0.07511 and 0.09187.
The model predicted the wrong held-out ordering and substantially underestimated 49x4 error.
Stage-1-only, stage-2-only and combined regressions produced effectively identical held-out predictions.
With fixed width=4, stage1_terms and stage2_terms are structurally coupled, preventing independent identification of their effects.
interpretation: Exp026 falsifies the proposed predictive model and reveals an identifiability problem in its calibration design. A factorial experiment that independently varies group count and feature width is required before fitting a genuine two-stage compatibility model.
next_research_direction: Run a factorial group-count by feature-width diagnostic, measuring stage-local and end-to-end discrepancy, to break the stage-1/stage-2 accumulation coupling.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
Only three held-out topologies were tested.
